runtime.pytest: 8 passed: channel turn unit and pipeline integration tests

implementation: Channel turn groups preserve every segment timestamp. Exact near-aligned transcript duplicates are only suppressed with an independently confirmed source-segment pair; otherwise both remain in the application transcript and the possible duplicate is flagged. Suppressed and candidate segments retain source IDs, channel indexes, time ranges, and a clinician-review log.
limitations: Text and time similarity alone cannot distinguish cross-talk from two people saying the same thing.
This repository does not yet provide an acoustic duplicate confirmation signal.
Channel identity is not a verified speaker role.
